class.name: SteamPublisherPurchaseOrderResult
class.description: Distinguishes an absent order from a store or lookup failure, so a reconciliation cursor never skips an order when storage is unavailable.

method.name: create
method.description: Constructs a durable lookup result. Use [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] only when storage confirms absence. An OK result with a null [param value] becomes [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA].

method.name: get_value
method.description: Exact persisted order, or null on failure.

members.member: Exact persisted order, or null on failure.
